title.en: Move every wallet surface to the managed Reown project
title.zh: 将全部钱包界面迁移到可管理的 Reown 项目

purpose.en: Replace the retired shared WalletConnect project identifier in membership, AutoSwap, and StableSwap while preserving site-isolated commerce resources.
purpose.zh: 在会员、AutoSwap 与 StableSwap 中替换停用的共享 WalletConnect 项目标识，同时保留站点隔离的商务资源。

en: Use the Reown project managed by bingliu@cybeye.com for membership, AutoSwap, and StableSwap WalletConnect sessions.
Keep injected-wallet and WalletConnect paths available with each existing site-owned contract.
Add a contract test covering all three wallet entry points and rejecting the retired project identifier.
zh: 会员、AutoSwap 与 StableSwap 的 WalletConnect 会话改用由 bingliu@cybeye.com 管理的 Reown 项目。
保留注入式钱包与 WalletConnect 路径，并继续使用各自既有的本站合约。
新增覆盖三个钱包入口的契约测试，禁止重新引入停用的项目标识。

en: GreatLoveMeta membership checkout, AutoSwap, StableSwap, and admin wallet connections.
zh: 影响 GreatLoveMeta 会员结账、AutoSwap、StableSwap 与管理员钱包连接。

en: Change only the public Reown project identifier; preserve this site's plans, prices, contracts, tokens, payout settings, member data and Cloudflare resources.
zh: 仅变更公开的 Reown 项目标识；保留本站套餐、价格、合约、代币、收款设置、会员数据及 Cloudflare 资源。

en: Run the complete build and test suite, zero-warning ESLint, and the dedicated Reown contract, then verify production bundles and Project evidence without sending a real payment.
zh: 运行完整构建与测试、零警告 ESLint及专用 Reown 契约，再验证生产资源包及 Project 证据；不发送真实付款。

en: No real payment is sent and no realtime audio/video test is started.
zh: 未发送真实付款，未启动实时音视频测试。

en: Preserve GreatLoveMeta branding, local membership catalog, login-protected navigation rules, referral identifiers and site-owned SmartPay5 configuration.
zh: 保留 GreatLoveMeta 品牌、本地会员目录、登录受保护导航规则、推荐标识及站点独立 SmartPay5 配置。

rollback.en: Roll back the application release; no data migration is required.
rollback.zh: 回滚应用版本；无需数据迁移。
